correctness.rationale: For even reduced spectra, every Chebyshev index \(2\lambda_k\) is odd, so \(P\) is odd. The cited transfer-time root has multiplicity \(2n-1\), and the change of variable \(x=\cos(t/2)\) is locally simple there. Dividing by \(x^{2n-1}\) leaves an even polynomial of degree \(2\lambda_n-2n+1\); positive roots consume degree in \(\pm x\) pairs. This proves the bound for multiplicities, hence also for distinct times.

value.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly studies how many ESE events can occur before first PST and gives a dedicated even-order upper bound. The parity refinement improves that central quantitative statement for every even reduced spectrum and gives an immediate zero-ESE threshold at the minimal spectral endpoint. It therefore constrains repeated exclusion/re-injection opportunities without adding model assumptions.
